narr: A weak area of low pressure from southern California through southern Nevada helped draw monsoon moisture northward across Arizona. Scattered showers and storms developed over the high terrain. A few of the storms produced rain rates of nearly 2 inches an hour.
ev: The Verde River near Camp Verde rose almost two feet with a crest of 4.39 feet at 6:00 PM MST (VAVA3).
lsr: RISE FROM 2.49 FEET TO A CREST OF 4.39 FEET ON THE VERDE RIVER AT GAUGE VAVA3.
